name: B10-0500/2025 – After recital E – Am 2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on protection of EU consumers against the practices of certain e-commerce platforms: the case of child-like sex dolls, weapons and other illegal products and materials
part_text: Ea. whereas the Swedish Government summoned Amazon and other e-commerce platforms to a meeting after child rights organisation ChildX filed a police report over the sale of child-like sex dolls on those websites;
